title: Syncra HUD
description: A next-gen upcoming HUD mod that's currently in BETA.
body:
Looking for a mod that displays information for you? I got you covered!
Whether on singleplayer, multi-player, or so on - it has it's purpose.

**Current Features:**

  **Armor HUD:** Shows your armor, alongside with Durability,
  
  **Health / Armor (values) display:** Shows current health, and armor points.

  **Speedometer / Accelerometer:** Shows current speed, and acceleration.

  **FPS / TPS display:** Shows server TPS, and client FPS.
 
  **More coming soon...**

Q&A: *What do I plan working on?*
  **For now, the mod will display basic information. However, I will soon introduce support for custom items (I do not know the exact features yet!)**
 
Q&A: *Is it customizable?*
  **Yes! It has customization, I will be working on more customization features, and I will prioritize requested ones if possible.**
  
Q&A: *What versions does it support?*
  **So far, only NeoForge. I will definitely do my best to add more support later on in the future.**

*Any feedback will be really appreciated! <3*
